messages:
Ellen: Heads up  we have a school group tour tomorrow at 10:00 (10 kids + 8 chaperones). Two chaperones asked about stroller space and one child uses an epi-pen. Also a framed set of blueprints is arriving at 09:30 and a helium balloon delivery at 09:45 for a birthday surprise. Can we coordinate staging and allergy-safe snacks?
frontdesk-bot: Event pre-reg: School Tour  18 guests, ETA 10:00. Volunteer badges: lime. Accessibility: stroller spot requested. Medical note: epi-pen on-site  host informed. Reply 'confirm' to reserve.
mail-bot: Package inbound 09:30: "Framed Blueprints - DO NOT LAY FLAT"; 09:45: "Helium Balloons - HANDLE WITH CARE". Current scan: Nighthold shelf D2.
Mark: I'll meet them at 09:55 at the side door and help with strollers. For the blueprints, please keep in Locker 4 (flat shelf). Don't stack anything on top.
Hannah: I'll bring laminated parent sign-in sheets and printable lime volunteer lanyards. Also ordering nut-free snack boxes for 09:50. Any other dietary restrictions?
Facilities: We can reserve the north alcove for stroller parking and a small folding table for sign-in. Locker 4 is free until 11:30; will stage blueprints there at 09:35. Balloons should be left deflated in Nighthold D2 until 09:40.
Sasha: Quick note: balloons can set off the HVAC sensors if released near ceiling vents. Please inflate only in the demo hall after kids are escorted in.
Ellen: Good catch. frontdesk-bot, please add explicit note: inflate in Demo Hall B only, keep away from vents. Also flag blueprints as fragile orientation: keep flat.
frontdesk-bot: Check-in flow for front desk:
```
1) Ask for reservation name
2) Print lime volunteer lanyards + parent visitor stickers
3) Log medical note (epi-pen) and attach to host contact
4) Direct strollers to north alcove (roped)
5) Escort group to Demo Hall B; inflate balloons there after seating
```
Ben: I'll take the balloon duty and inflate in Demo Hall B at 10:10 after kids are seated. I'll bring the low-weight helium tank and a cord to tether balloons to the table.
mail-bot: Blueprint moved to Locker 4 at 09:34 by Facilities. Balloons scanned and held in Nighthold D2.
Mark: One small logistics ask: can someone reserve 3 extra chairs in Demo Hall B for chaperones and a small folding mat for the child with epi-pen to sit near teacher?
Facilities: Adding 3 chairs + hypoallergenic mat near front row. Also leaving a small allergy-safe snack tray labeled for the epi-pen child.
Hannah: Snack boxes ordered and labeled nut-free. I'll also print an emergency contact card to hand to the lead chaperone.
Sasha: Reminder: volunteers to wear bright lime lanyards and lead the kids in a single-file line through corridors. Please avoid the open kitchen area.
Ellen: I'll brief volunteers at 09:50 in foyer. Ben, please don't inflate balloons until I give the go-ahead.
Ben: Roger that. I'll wait for Ellen's thumbs-up.
Facilities: Leaving dolly and blanket at Locker 4 for the framed blueprints. Postpone handing blueprints to host until after tour to avoid accidental bumps.
frontdesk-bot: Final reminders: Balloons to be inflated in Demo Hall B only; Blueprints stored flat in Locker 4; Stroller parking in north alcove; Volunteer badges printed lime; Nut-free snacks arriving 09:50.
Ellen: Amazing, team. Thank you  I'll post a short arrival note to the group and close this thread after check-in.
